description: This file defines API endpoints related to 'recipes' using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for listing recipes with filtering and sorting, retrieving a specific recipe by ID, and creating a placeholder recipe. It leverages internal modules for data, schemas, and utility functions, and references external FastAPI components.

methods.description: Endpoint to list recipes with optional filtering by query, category, ingredients, and sorting.
